If there are both a level 4 or lower blue Digimon card and a level 4 or lower green Digimon card in the digivolution cards, you can't choose to only play one of them.
Card Q&A.q: If there’s both a level 4 or lower blue Digimon card and a level 4 or lower green Digimon card in this Digimon’s digivolution cards, does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect require me to play both of them?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower blue and 1 level 4 or lower green Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the costs.
